Excavation Progress.title: Excavation Progress – Key Subareas
Excavation Progress.headline: 100% Completion achieved in Subareas 4E, 3A, and 3B.
Excavation Progress.description: We have declared 100% completion for both DOL and OCP contaminated soils in Subareas 4E, 3A, and 3B. In the remaining sectors, work is accelerating: Subarea 4A is nearing the finish line with 92% DOL completion, while Subarea 4D and 4C are tackling complex contamination layers.

Logistics & Reintegration.title: Logistics & Reintegration – Closing the Loop
Logistics & Reintegration.headline: Over 2.2 million tons transported and substantial restoration underway.
Logistics & Reintegration.description: The logistics operation is massive. We have transported over 2.27 million tons of contaminated soil to date. Simultaneously, we are closing the loop by returning treated soil to the earth, specifically filling Gatch Pits 14 and 49 with clean, remediated material.
focus: Efficient sorting of ENA vs. Treatment Pad material
Mixing 1-2% TPH soil into gatch pits (472k tons complete)

Treatment Pad Operations.title: Treatment Pad – Bioremediation
Treatment Pad Operations.headline: 100% Success rate for planned 2-to-5% TPH batches.
Treatment Pad Operations.description: The scale of remediation is evident at the pad, where we have screened over 2.7 million tons of soil. Our biological processes are delivering solid results: all 76 planned batches for 2-to-5% TPH soil have successfully achieved the Remediation Target Criteria (RTC).
focus: Bioremediation of 116,448 tons of 7-10% TPH soil
Verification of RTC for Portion 4 Mix batches

Soil Washing Plant.title: Soil Washing – Mechanical Treatment
Soil Washing Plant.headline: Phase Two operational: Turning high-TPH soil into clean output.
Soil Washing Plant.description: The Soil Washing Plant is fully active, handling higher-concentration soils (7-to-10% TPH). This mechanical process allows us to recover clean soil from material that is difficult to treat biologically. We are rapidly increasing the feed rate and output efficiency.

Landfill Facility.title: Landfill Facility – Containment
Landfill Facility.headline: Transitioned from construction to active infilling.
Landfill Facility.description: All major construction activities, including liner installation and drainage systems, are 100% complete. The facility has transitioned to active operations, receiving waste from our excavations as well as our partners Enshaat and Al-Ghanim International.
focus: Closing out final punch list items
